title: Libra, you are allowed to tip the scale
caption: for the libras who said whatever you want

scenes.text: libra, stay with me for one minute.
venus rules you, so you were born knowing how beauty should sit.
the right word, the right light, the chair that softens a room.
and you carry the scales, weighing every side before you speak.
you see their point so clearly, you forget you had one.
you keep the peace so well, nobody notices you paid for it.
but balance was never meant to mean you weigh nothing.
a scale with you missing from it isn't fair. it's just quiet.
so say the honest thing, even if it makes the room uneven.
the people worth keeping can hold a little disagreement.
venus runs your heart. let her want something out loud.
you're allowed to be the thing that tips the scale.
goodnight, libra. order the dessert you actually want.
